clinicalNotes: 6 weeks of change in bowel habit with looser stools and 5kg unintentional weight loss. Bloods show iron deficiency anaemia (Hb 98). No family history noted.
Intermittent bloating and abdominal discomfort for 2 years, related to meals, relieved by opening bowels. Weight stable, bloods normal. Tried low FODMAP diet with partial benefit. Query IBS.
3 months of heartburn and upper abdominal pain not settling on 8 weeks of omeprazole. No weight loss, no difficulty swallowing. Requesting specialist review and consideration of endoscopy.
New difficulty swallowing solid foods over the past 4 weeks, feels food sticking behind the breastbone. Has lost some weight. Ex-smoker.
Central chest tightness on walking uphill for the last 3 weeks, settles with rest within 5 minutes. Episodes becoming more frequent. ECG at rest normal. Hypertensive.
Occasional palpitations for 1 year, lasting seconds, often after coffee. No dizziness, no fainting, no chest pain. ECG normal. Anxious about symptoms, requesting reassurance.
Known heart murmur. Echo 2 years ago showed moderate aortic stenosis. Asymptomatic, walks daily without limitation. Due for routine surveillance review.
Pigmented mole on the back that the patient's partner says has grown and changed colour over 3 months. Irregular border, 8mm, occasionally itchy.
Long-standing mild eczema on both hands, controlled with emollients and occasional mild steroid cream. Requesting review of longer-term treatment options.
Moderate plaque psoriasis on elbows, knees and scalp, worsening over 6 months despite topical treatments. Affecting sleep and work. Considering systemic therapy.
